name: zrndr_draw_circle_octants16_framebuffer
description: zRndr_DrawCircleOctants16_Framebuffer emits the eight symmetric circle points through the active 16-bit framebuffer point callback.
known_limits: tier S evidence is tracked by the grouped zrndr_draw_circle_helpers VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x499020 validates fastcall y in ECX, x in EDX, packedColor on the stack, eight gRndr_pfnPointOpActive calls, and gRndr_pFrameBuffer plus g_zRndr_CircleCenterX/Y as inputs.
The native smoke patches the active point callback and verifies the exact eight emitted y/x/color tuples and framebuffer pointer.
